entry.title: ESQUE80 0.9.1
entry.summary: ESQUE80 is an 8-voice cross-wave synthesizer for Akai MPC standalone hardware: three wavetable oscillators per voice, a 4-pole low-pass filter, four envelopes with live touch-editable displays, three LFOs and a 15-source mod matrix with tap-to-pick routing, on an eleven-page touch panel. ## Changes since 0.9.0 - The data-conversion script has been removed from the project.
